Frontend fully verified: pricing shows exactly The Essential/$349, The Designer Series/$699 (Most popular), The Signature Series/Quote by project with correct feature lists and testids; all old tier names ('The Standard', 'The Upgrade', 'The Upgraded', 'The Landscape', 'Custom Requests') and old prices ('$299', '$1,499') absent from the page. Ritual of Quality section renders on navy with three lucide-icon cards (Professional Prep, Craftsman Finish, The P&P Stamp) with correct copy. Nav Ritual link scrolls to ritual section. Booking step 1 exposes exactly the six required data-testids; hero CTAs scroll correctly; package-select-{essential,designer,signature} + recover-cta all preselect the right service; empty-required submit shows an error toast; happy path yields booking-success + success toast; lead persists with the correct service string ('The Designer Series — craftsman finish'). Admin flow: /admin redirects to /admin/login unauthenticated, login with admin@postandpolish.com/Polish2026! loads dashboard, new lead visible with correct service, lead-status change persisted across admin-refresh (NEW -> CONTACTED), all filter buttons clickable, admin-logout returns to /admin/login. No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Landing.js/BookingForm.js: service-option data-testids are derived from option text via split(' —')[0].toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,'-'). Works today but is fragile — any future option whose prefix isn't unique (e.g. two 'The Signature' variants) would collide. Consider deriving from a stable key on the SERVICE_OPTIONS entries.
backend/server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — should migrate to FastAPI lifespan handlers (non-blocking, deprecation warnings only).

Legacy leads named 'Diag Test' with service 'The Standard — replacement' remain in the admin dashboard from earlier iterations. These are seed/test data, not from current code, but they display the retired tier label and may confuse the client. Suggest a one-time cleanup or reseed.
seed_data_creation: One transient UI-flow lead 'TEST_QA_UI Buyer' created and deleted after the run; login_attempts collection cleared as requested.
